messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Excellent! You now have excellent signal strength and are on a 5G network, which is great. However, I notice that VPN is still connected. VPN connections can sometimes cause speed drops or connectivity issues.

Please use the **disconnect_vpn** command on your device to disconnect the VPN. After you do that, let me know what your status bar shows, and we can then test your internet speed.

I disconnected the VPN. Now my status bar shows excellent signal strength, 5G network, mobile data enabled, no VPN, and battery at 80%. Should I run a speed test now to check the internet speed?

Please execute the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
